_comment: CliniX media registry AND licence gate. Nothing renders unless cleared === true with a real licence and attribution. This mirrors atlas-pipeline/sources.json require_clear(): the registry REFUSES uncleared media rather than documenting the problem in a comment. Contrast assets/kardiox-learn/, which holds 872 images with no manifest and no licence record at all.
_howToClear: SELF-AUTHORED (diagram/animation): set inline:true + diagramId, licence 'StewardMD original', attribution 'StewardMD'.
SYNTHESIZED audio: set synth:true + audioKind. It is generated, so there is no source to credit, but the UI must call it synthesized.

EMBED: verify with `curl 'https://www.youtube.com/oembed?url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=<ID>&format=json'`. HTTP 200 means public AND embeddable. Take attribution from author_name and title from title. Anything other than 200 must stay cleared:false.
HOSTED FILE: only for media that is openly licensed (CC0/CC BY/public domain) or owner-produced. Record licence, attribution and sourceUrl.
NEVER download, re-host, or strip attribution from third-party media. NEVER set cleared:true to make a screen look finished.
_status: Three media classes, all legally clean. (1) SELF-AUTHORED inline SVG diagrams and animations - we drew them, so they always clear. (2) SYNTHESIZED audio generated by Web Audio at play time - a teaching model of a sound, not a recording, with no rights holder, labelled as synthesized wherever it plays. (3) EMBEDDED YouTube via the official player - never downloaded, never re-hosted; embeddable:true is set ONLY after the YouTube oEmbed endpoint returned 200 for that video, which is the rights holder's own embedding switch, and the attribution is the channel name from that same response.

media.dia.flowvolume.caption: Flow-volume loop: the scooped expiratory limb of obstruction
media.dia.flowvolume.note: The number is abstract; the scoop is what a student recognises on a report.

media.dia.airtrapping.caption: Loss of radial traction: the airway closes and gas is trapped
media.dia.airtrapping.note: Nearly every COPD sign derives from this one mechanism.

media.dia.percussion.note: Teaches the ORDER, which is the part students get wrong.

media.dia.percussiontech.note: Teaches HOW, where the map teaches WHERE.

media.dia.expansion.caption: Chest expansion: thumbs floating compared with anchored
media.dia.expansion.note: The single highest-value diagram in the set: anchored thumbs make the sign vanish.

media.dia.auscultation.note: Interactive, and each site plays its synthesized sound.

media.dia.hoover.caption: Hoover sign: why a flat diaphragm pulls the ribs in

media.dia.barrel.caption: Barrel chest: AP diameter compared with normal, from the side

media.dia.trachea.caption: Tracheal position and the cricosternal distance
media.dia.trachea.note: One finger, and where the distance is measured.

media.dia.clubbing.caption: Nail-fold angle and the Schamroth window
media.dia.clubbing.note: Side-by-side normal and abnormal beats either alone.

media.dia.effusionshift.caption: Which way the mediastinum moves: pushed away or pulled towards
media.dia.effusionshift.note: The distinction that separates effusion from collapse.

media.dia.breathing.caption: Breathing patterns compared, at their real relative rates
media.dia.breathing.note: Shows that a falling rate in exhaustion is ominous, not better.

media.snd.vesicular.caption: Vesicular breath sounds (synthesized)
media.snd.vesicular.note: The normal reference a student needs before any abnormal makes sense.

media.snd.bronchial.caption: Bronchial breathing (synthesized)
media.snd.bronchial.note: Note the GAP between phases; that is the discriminator.

media.snd.reduced.caption: Reduced breath sounds with prolonged expiration (synthesized)

media.snd.wheeze.caption: Polyphonic expiratory wheeze (synthesized)
media.snd.wheeze.note: Many notes at once: diffuse obstruction.

media.snd.monophonic.caption: Fixed monophonic wheeze (synthesized)
media.snd.monophonic.note: ONE note: a single narrowed airway. Tumour until proven otherwise.

media.snd.coarse.caption: Early coarse crackles (synthesized)
media.snd.coarse.note: Pair with the fine crackle; the contrast IS the lesson.

media.snd.fine.caption: Fine late inspiratory crackles (synthesized)
media.snd.fine.note: Contrast pair for the coarse crackle.

media.snd.stridor.caption: Stridor (synthesized)
media.snd.stridor.note: Inspiratory and an emergency. Not a wheeze.
